cross_verification.note_en: Nigeria Immigration Service's official e-Visa knowledge base confirms 'Recent Passport-Size Photos' as a required document for e-Visa applications, but publishes no numeric size/background/head-height specification for this document type. The Domestic Passport Application Portal's image-compliance tool (documented in ng-passport.json: 35×45mm, white background, 29-34mm head height, <2MB, 600×800px) is operated by the same agency (Nigeria Immigration Service) but the visa portal (visa.immigration.gov.ng) is a separate application requiring login, and its photo-upload spec screen could not be reached without authentication, so those figures are not carried over here as verified for ng-visa specifically.
